base_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: neutral base portrait for a codec-style radio-call character, to be animated through separate mouth and eyelid patches. Create ONE square 1024x1024 PNG. Original mature graphic-novel character painting, restrained realistic anatomy, painterly but crisp facial features, muted cinematic color. Front-facing, upright and centered head-and-shoulders, whole head and both ears visible, head fixed vertically with eyes near 43 percent canvas height and mouth near 63 percent. Eyes fully OPEN looking at viewer; lips gently CLOSED, relaxed neutral expression. Face is clearly illuminated with soft even key light; preserve visible detail in the cheeks and jaw, avoid underexposure. Plain quiet charcoal-teal backdrop. Radio framing and scanlines are supplied by the app: NO border, UI, text, letters, symbols, logos, scanlines, glow or watermark. One person only, no props crossing the face, no expressive head tilt. This is the base state, not a speaking or blinking pose. A Black woman in her early forties, medium-brown skin, short close natural curls with one silver streak at the temple, warm dark eyes, square practical jaw, slightly asymmetric brows, calm dry wit. Amber-brown field jacket with a simple dark collar and a small understated radio earpiece. Competent approachable original civilian operations coordinator.
